body:
Found via a monorepo-wide CI health sweep (checked MJOLNIR/IDUNA/emily.cli/PRRJECT_FATBABY/EmilyOS/PITVIPER/SKULDMARK): EmilyOS's 'Build emilyos binary (static)' CI step had been broken since 2026-08-26 (CGO_ENABLED=0 predates internal/fsaclmod, a real cgo-based PARENA mod added in commit eb6b867 -- build constraints excluded the whole package, real build failure). go test ./... never caught it (runs with cgo enabled by default). Fixed by enabling cgo for the build step too, matching PITVIPER's own established precedent for cgo+PARENA-mod integration in this monorepo; renamed the step to drop the now-inaccurate 'static' claim. Verified locally: go test clean, real build succeeds, binary runs. CI green, run 33138377129. EmilyOS commit 2147f89. (MJOLNIR's own CI failure was also checked and confirmed to be a real, already-known, unrelated blocker -- missing google-services.json -- not touched.)

⚓ ☃
title: CI fix: enable cgo for the emilyos build (fsaclmod needs it)
